_about: Firmware menu of the reader simulator. repo = GitHub owner/name. status: ready (built and run on Windows here), untested (has a simulator setup, not tried yet), broken (its own simulator setup does not build, also on Linux), adapter (no simulator setup; the reader simulator adds one), unsupported (cannot run in this simulator). frame: the reader picture with clickable keys works (both simulator libraries since 2026-10-20). Sources: readme.club/firmware and GitHub, checked and built on Windows 2026-10-20 (tools/try_all.sh). Versions are read live from each repo's releases. Order: the order the app and the web page list the firmwares in (VARAGH, CrossPoint Reader, CrossInk first). refs: branches to build instead of the newest releases (rebuilt every run).

firmwares.name: VARAGH
firmwares.about: CrossInk fork: dictionaries, Persian, games, Control Center. Built and tested 1.2.1 for X4 Pro, X4 Classic and X3. Its freeink-sdk submodule (PewPewzxc/freeink-sdk) is private; the build workflows fetch it with a read-only deploy key.

firmwares.name: CrossPoint Reader
firmwares.about: The original open-source firmware. No simulator setup of its own; the reader simulator adds one (crosspoint-simulator library from the firmware's date). Built and tested 1.6.5 and 2.0.0rc for X4 Pro, X4 Classic and X3.

firmwares.name: CrossInk
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork with X3, X4 Classic and X4 Pro support. Built and tested v1.6.1 for all three.

firmwares.name: Witchhunt Reader
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork (from Dave Allie's CrossPoint, MIT) by jpirnay, for the X4, X3 and X4 Pro (and the LilyGo T5 S3, which the simulator does not have). No simulator setup of its own; the reader simulator adds one (adapter.py, crosspoint-simulator library). Its freeink-sdk submodule is jpirnay's public fork. Does not build yet (2.38 to 2.40): it uses a newer display, clock and font interface (HalDisplay::finishDisplayAsync, HalClock::formatLogTime, FlashFontPartition.h) than either public simulator library has; kept untested so new releases are tried.

firmwares.name: xpoint
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork by belphemur (MIT), for the X4, X3 and X4 Pro. No simulator setup of its own; the reader simulator adds one (adapter.py). Its freeink-sdk submodule is belphemur's public fork. Does not build yet (2.7.2 to 2.8.1): it uses a newer hardware layer (HalDisplay::refreshBusy, PSRAM functions, image decoders' openRAM) than either public simulator library has; kept untested so new releases are tried.

firmwares.name: CrossSmudge
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork by Mumfee (MIT), with its own simulator setup for the X4 Pro, X4 Classic and X3. Browser builds of 1.6.5.1 to 1.6.5.3 pass for all three readers (2026-10-21).

firmwares.name: inkmod
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork by alpzoloto-sudo (MIT), for the X3, X4 Classic and X4 Pro. No simulator setup of its own; the reader simulator adds one (adapter.py). Added 2026-10-21, not built yet.

firmwares.name: crosslink
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork by DaisonChun (MIT). No simulator setup of its own; the reader simulator adds one (adapter.py). Added 2026-10-21, not built yet.

firmwares.name: InkPointX
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork by yokki-vans (MIT), built from its dev branch (refs), rebuilt every run because the branch moves. No simulator setup of its own; the reader simulator adds one (adapter.py). Its SDK submodule is yokki-vans/community-sdk. Added 2026-10-20, not built yet.

firmwares.name: YACP
firmwares.about: Opinionated CrossPoint fork focused on battery life and rendering. X4 and X3. Built and tested v1.8.1-yacp.9 (older crosspoint-simulator library; the frame works there now).

firmwares.name: CrossInk Bookorbit
firmwares.about: CrossInk fork. Its simulator setup does not build: its code needs HalClock::syncSystemTimeFromNTP (and canDisplayTime), which no public simulator library version has (tested v1.6.1+bookorbit.2 with the dated and the newest library).

firmwares.name: CrossNotes
firmwares.about: CrossInk fork. Built and tested v1.2.1 for all three models.

firmwares.name: Xteink Pokemon game
firmwares.about: Reading-powered Pokemon companion game, built on CrossInk. Built and tested v0.1.1 for all three models.

firmwares.name: CrossDiTo
firmwares.about: CrossInk fork for the X4 Pro. Built and tested v1.5.1 (X4 Pro only).

firmwares.name: CrossPDF
firmwares.about: CrossInk fork with PDF. Its simulator setup does not build: its own code does not compile for the simulator ('epub_' and 'icon_pointer_off_24' not declared; tested crosspdf-v1.6.1-rc.1).

firmwares.name: Ink-boy
firmwares.about: CrossInk fork. Its simulator setup does not build: its C file src/walnut_cgb_impl.c includes the simulator's esp_heap_caps.h, which is C++ only (tested 3.0.0).

firmwares.name: PocketDeck OS
firmwares.about: CrossInk fork. No releases; built and tested the main branch for all three models.

firmwares.name: inx
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork for the X4. Does not build on Windows: its platformio.ini writes -include${PROJECT_DIR}/..., and the Windows backslashes in that path are lost (would need a change in the firmware). Tested 1.0.20-BETA. 2026-10-20: tried again (the browser build on Linux has no backslash problem).

firmwares.name: aalu
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork for the X4. Builds and starts, but it pins an old simulator library (crosspoint-simulator efe37c6) without scripted input and screenshots, so it cannot be tested here and the frame does not fit (tested v3.3.0).

firmwares.name: Foulad eInk
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork. Its simulator setup does not build: FreeInkApp.h (FreeInk UI library) is not part of its simulator setup (tested v1.8.99-rc+edc5cd6).

firmwares.name: duet
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork for the X4. Built and tested v0.1.0-alpha.9 (X4 Classic; older simulator library, frame works).

firmwares.name: Folio Nooir
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork for the X3. Does not build on Windows: the tjpgd.h in its freeink-sdk declares its own uint32_t when _WIN32 is set, which clashes with the compiler's (tested 1.6.5).

firmwares.name: KatiePoint
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork with Bluetooth, Hardcover and BookFusion. Its simulator setup expects the simulator library in a folder next to the firmware (../crosspoint-simulator), so it does not build from a download (tested 1.13.0-rc1).

firmwares.name: CrossPlant
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork. Its simulator setup does not build: it needs HWCDC::read(buffer, size), which the simulator library lacks (tested CrossPlant_v0.1.4).

firmwares.name: CrumBLE
firmwares.about: CrossInk fork for the X4. Its simulator setup does not build: its code needs simulator functions (readFileWithFallback, freertos/portmacro.h) that no public simulator version has.

firmwares.name: cpr-vcodex
firmwares.about: CrossPoint fork. Its simulator setup does not build: HalHaptics.h is missing from its pinned simulator library. 2026-10-20: tried again; its simulator library is boydj/crosspoint-simulator#cpr-vcodex, which carries its HAL stubs.

firmwares.name: vcodex on steroids
firmwares.about: cpr-vcodex fork. Cannot be downloaded completely: its freeink-sdk submodule points at a commit that is not on GitHub (tested 1.6.0.38-dev1-cpr-vcodex-steroids).

firmwares.name: Xteink factory firmware
firmwares.about: Closed source: only .bin files (the X4 Classic and X4 Pro ones are encrypted). This simulator builds firmware from source, so it cannot run them.
